pre-commit.description: Renovate's pre-commit manager is disabled by default. Enable it so .pre-commit-config.yaml pins track the versions CI enforces; the ruff hook had drifted 13 minor versions behind uv.lock before this was turned on (#88).

packageRules.description: openapi-typescript reaches into the TypeScript compiler API (ts.factory), which the TS 7 Go port does not expose, so `npm run gen:types` crashes at module load. openapi-typescript's latest (7.13.0) still declares peerDependencies.typescript ^5.x and no 8.x exists. Lift this cap once openapi-typescript ships TS 7 support; tracked in #93. NOTE: PR #80 was closed unmerged, so Renovate will skip re-creating that branch even after the cap lifts -- tick `typescript` on the Dependency Dashboard (#3) to force it.
